drift_resolved.description: The specification defines a complete test failure triage system with commands like `speky test triage <spec-id>`, categorization logic (regression/outdated/flaky), confidence scoring, and progressive disclosure UI. However, the actual code in speky_testing.py only has basic test runner infrastructure and enum definitions (TriageCategory, TriageResult) but no implementation of the core triage analysis logic, AI categorization engine, or the specific triage command.

The specification requires integration with "existing SPEKY test runner modules (FlutterTestRunner, PytestRunner, JestRunner)" but the actual speky_testing.py code only contains configuration references to these frameworks in DEFAULT_TESTING_CONFIG, not actual runner implementations or integrations.
drift_resolved.suggestion: Implement the actual test runner classes and their integration with the triage system as specified.
drift_resolved.spec_name: integration with "existing SPEKY test runner modules (FlutterTestRunner, PytestRunner, JestRunner)"

drift_resolved.description: The specification details file access patterns for specs, git history, and VCS integration with specific command patterns like `git diff --name-only HEAD~1..HEAD`, but the actual code has no git integration or file change tracking implementation.
drift_resolved.suggestion: Implement the git integration and file change tracking components as detailed in the specification's "File Access Patterns" section.
drift_resolved.spec_name: triage - file access patterns for specs, git history, and VCS integration

drift_resolved.description: The specification requires enhanced `speky complete` flow integration showing triage summaries when tests fail, but the main speky.py file has no test failure handling or triage integration in any completion workflow.
drift_resolved.suggestion: Integrate the triage system with the complete command workflow as specified in the requirements.

drift_resolved.description: The actual speky_testing.py code includes TDD workflow states (TDDState enum with states like RED_CONFIRMED, GREEN_PASSED, REGRESSION_PASSED) and comprehensive test management features that are not documented in the test-failure-triage specification.

The specification defines a detailed progressive disclosure UI with specific interaction patterns, terminal formatting, and expandable sections, but the actual code has no UI implementation or output formatting logic.
drift_resolved.suggestion: Implement the progressive disclosure interface and terminal formatting system as specified in the "User Interface & Progressive Disclosure" section.
